requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication of users to prevent unauthorized access to attendance data.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization to maintain accurate attendance records across multiple classes.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy.
The system shall store historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to support long-term analysis.
The system shall provide a logging mechanism for all attendance modifications to support accountability and traceability.
The system shall allow for manual overrides by authorized personnel in cases of system failure or error.
The system shall undergo regular security audits to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
The system shall ensure attendance data is processed in real-time to provide updates within 2 seconds of input.
The system shall support at least 500 concurrent users without performance degradation.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records with a response time of under 3 seconds and secure authentication.
The system shall generate attendance reports within a maximum of 12 seconds to ensure compliance and security.
The system shall implement load balancing to optimize resource utilization across multiple classes and semesters while ensuring energy efficiency.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing operations through efficient algorithms.
The system shall support cloud storage solutions that prioritize energy-efficient data centers.
The system shall allow for real-time attendance updates using low-energy communication protocols.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations when handling student attendance data.
The system shall provide transparency in attendance recording by logging all attendance changes with timestamps and user identification.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days of marking, with prioritized resources.
The system shall ensure that attendance reports include anonymized data to protect student identities.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict attendance data access to authorized personnel only.
The system shall maintain an audit log of all access and modifications to attendance records.
The system shall ensure that all student attendance data is encrypted at rest and in transit.

Anonymization compliance was prioritized over speed in report generation.
Load balancing and energy-efficient storage solutions were integrated to optimize resource usage.
Sustainability goals were prioritized over load balancing performance.
